Load master import file for a given colony

load_master_import.Rd

This function loads the master import file for a specified colony or directly from a file path. Either a colony name of a file path must be provided. It iterates through the appropriate sheets and combines the data into a list of data frames.

Usage

load_master_import(colony = NULL, file_path = NULL, use_stored = TRUE)

Arguments

colony

A character string specifying the name of the colony.

file_path

File path of master import file

use_stored

If TRUE, use a pre-existing path, rather than searching for a new one. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A LoadedWB object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
load_master_import("ColonyA")
} # }
